command: set -eu; echo '===IDENTITY==='; hostname; id -un; date -Is; echo '===VM==='; systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p DropInPaths --no-pager; echo '===MACHINECTL==='; machinectl --version | head -1; machinectl bind --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,140p'; echo '===OPENERS_CGROUP==='; for p in $(sudo -n lsof -t /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db 2>/dev/null | sort -u); do echo PID:$p; sudo -n tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$p/cmdline; echo; sudo -n cat /proc/$p/cgroup; done; echo '===SERVICES==='; sudo -n systemctl -M entityos list-units --type=service --state=running --no-pager --no-legend | grep -E 'frankenstein|entityos' || true; echo '===DURABLE_TARGET==='; sudo -n stat -c '%n %F %U:%G %a' /var/lib/entityos/data; sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data -maxdepth 2 -type d -printf '%p|%u:%g|%m\n' | grep -E 'semantic|state|agentzero|frank' | head -80 || true; echo PREFLIGHT_ONLY_NO_MUTATION=1
